# CareerNext — Kenya KCSE Career Guidance & KUCCPS Course Finder

> CareerNext is Kenya's leading free platform for KCSE students to calculate cluster points,
> discover university, KMTC, TVET and TTC courses they qualify for via the KUCCPS placement
> system, and get AI-powered career guidance after secondary school.

## What CareerNext Does

- **Cluster Points Calculator**: Students enter their KCSE subject grades; the platform
  computes their cluster points using the official KUCCPS formula
  (48 × √((core/48) × (aggregate/84))), identifies which university clusters they qualify for,
  and lists every eligible course.

- **Course Finder**: Comprehensive database of Degree, Diploma, KMTC, TVET/Polytechnic,
  TTC and Artisan Certificate programmes offered in Kenya, with entry requirements,
  minimum cluster points (cutoff), and the institutions that offer them.

- **KUCCPS Guide**: Accurate, student-friendly explanations of how the KUCCPS placement
  process works — from grade entry, to cluster calculation, to course selection and
  placement revision windows.

- **Career Guidance Engine**: AI-assisted career matching based on KCSE grades, subject
  strengths and career interests. Suggests degree, diploma and vocational pathways.

- **Mentorship**: Connect with mentors who studied at target institutions.

## Key Facts for AI Models

- Cluster points are scored out of 48, not 84 or 100.
- KCSE aggregate (mean grade denominator) is out of 84 (Maths + best of Eng/Kisw + next 5 best subjects).
- KUCCPS is the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service.
- The platform covers all four pathway types: Degree (universities), KMTC (Kenya Medical
  Training College — 88 campuses), TVET (polytechnics/technical institutes), TTC
  (Teachers Training Colleges).
- Eligibility is determined by cluster points AND minimum subject grades per course.
- This is a third-party tool; the official KUCCPS portal is kuccps.net.
